title: Several companion personal quests (Two Keepers/Rowan in Thornwold's Understory, Berin's Coin Road to Gullhaven, the sealed letter back to Fenmarch) are planted early but their targets sit dozens of turns away in regions you may have already left, with no in-fiction cue about how costly the round trip will be until you check status and do the mental map yourself.
